_comment: The look of a vertical Short cut from a finished 16:9 sketch-film episode (scripts/episode-short.py). The episode is cropped to a 4:5 window that follows the action and set full width in a 1080x1920 frame, over a blurred copy of itself; the Short's headline sits on a card in the top band, in the film's own paper/ink/accent (read from its sketch.json player block); the narration is captioned word by word from the film's own word timings, centred at 75% of the height (Shorts guidebook rules 24-27).

picture._aspect: 4:5 of a 1080-high episode is 864 px of its 1920: the cast and the meter both fit, and the picture is 1.25x the source, which stays crisp on a crayon line. A 9:16 window (608 px) would cut the meter and the props round the cast.
